name: AJAZZ AK650
description: The AJAZZ AK650 punches way above its weight class, offering premium features like a flex-cut polycarbonate plate, 5-pin hot-swappable PCB, and a rare display and slider combo in a tight 65% form factor. An absolute dream for Windows users on a budget.
specs:
Layout: 65%

Mounting Style: Gasket Mount (Silicon jackets with flex-cut PC plate)

Connectivity: Tri-Mode (Wired, 2.4GHz, Bluetooth)

Battery Capacity: 5000 mAh

Switches: Huano Dreamweaving or Flying Fish (Linear, Factory Lubed)

PCB: 5-Pin Hot-Swappable, South-facing RGB, 1.2mm flex cut

Keycaps: Double-shot PBT (Cherry Profile)

Polling Rate: 1000Hz (Wired/2.4GHz), 125Hz (Bluetooth)

name: Judicial Collab DK1
description: A detailed review of the Judicial Collab DK1 60%, covering its unique marble-like design, mounting options, acoustics, PCB, build experience, and typing feel.
specs:
Layouts: Standard 60% / WKL / HHKB
Top Case: CNC-machined aluminum
Bottom Case Options: Copper / Brass
Back Plate Options: Aluminum / Copper
Plate Options: Polycarbonate / FR4 / Aluminum
PCB: 1.6 mm non-flex-cut
PCB Socket: 5-pin hot-swap
Switch Orientation: South-facing
RGB: No
Mounting: Plate gasket / PCB gasket / Hybrid
Wireless: 2.4 GHz
Polling Rate: 1000 Hz
Battery: 2400 mAh on final wireless PCB
Programming: QMK
Daughterboard: Unified daughterboard with magnetic connector
Stabilizers: Plate-mounted, included
Case Angle: 8°

name: Monka 3087 Pro V2
